_comment: STAGING MANIFEST for the LPAutoBalancerV2 Tenderly harness run. NOT a deployment record.
Every address here exists ONLY on the Tenderly Virtual TestNet named by chainId below. None of
them have code on Base mainnet, and a fresh vnet reassigns them on the next run.
Deliberately NOT in addresses/8453.json: proposal 011 gates deployment on
`if (!addresses.isAddressSet("MAMO_LP_AUTO_BALANCER_V2"))`, so registering a vnet address there
would make the production Safe run SKIP the deploy and wire itself to a contract that does not
The vnet RPC endpoint is NOT recorded here. A Tenderly vnet URL is effectively a bearer
credential -- it grants the cheat RPCs (tenderly_setBalance, tenderly_setStorageAt, evm_*) to
anyone holding it. Read it from TENDERLY_VNET_RPC_URL in .env, which is gitignored.

balanced.note: main minted straddling spot; staked into the gauge before reset()

singlesided.note: main minted entirely above spot (100% WETH); exercises the _mainRange single-sided branch

notDeployed.lpCompoundModule: The harness does not deploy LPCompoundModule -- it exercises the balancer's no-swap path only. The CowSwap compound/swap-rebalance legs are covered by the unit suite and gated on the checker-owner tx (handbook 7.1).
